tickerText: [TENNIS] Talia Gibson upset Roland-Garros finalist Maja Chwalińska 7-5, 6-1 in Toronto as world No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka cruised past Moyuka Uchijima 6-3, 6-3 at the Canadian Open • [SQUASH] Egypt's Salman Khalil swept Nasir Iqbal 14-12, 11-3, 13-11 to win the PN Fleet Club Open in Karachi — the first PSA World Event of 2026/27 • [BADMINTON] The BWF World Championships draw ceremony takes place today in New Delhi ahead of the August 17–23 worlds at Indira Gandhi Arena, with PV Sindhu seeded ninth • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Tour Europe launches with a 20-event inaugural season across nine countries, as the PPA Asia 500 Ho Chi Minh City Open opens tomorrow • [TABLE TENNIS] Sreeja Akula reached her first WTT Champions round of 16 with a win over Sofia Polcanova as Yokohama's $500K event continues at the BUNTAI

newsItems.title: Gibson Stuns at Canadian Open
newsItems.excerpt: Talia Gibson upset 18th seed Maja Chwalińska 7-5, 6-1 in Toronto as the National Bank Open builds toward the US Open.

newsItems.title: Khalil Wins Karachi Crown
newsItems.excerpt: Egypt's Salman Khalil swept past Pakistan's Nasir Iqbal 14-12, 11-3, 13-11 to claim the PN Fleet Club Open in Karachi.

newsItems.title: PPA Tour Europe Launches
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA announced PPA Tour Europe — a 20-event inaugural season across nine countries with a €545,000 prize pool.

newsItems.title: Akula Breaks Through in Yokohama
newsItems.excerpt: India's Sreeja Akula reached her first WTT Champions round of 16, beating Sofia Polcanova as day two continues in Yokohama.
